title: Next offer per customer
question: Which offer should each customer get next, and why?
story: {offers} offers are ready for {customers} customers, worth {worth} if they convert at the expected rate.
questions: Which offer converts best for new customers?
Which customers have no good offer?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.as_of_date, r.entity AS customer_id, c.customer_name, r.item, r.score, r.reason, c.region, c.channel, c.plan_type FROM main.sales.next_offer_out AS o JOIN main.sales.next_offer_out__recs AS r ON r.entity = o.entity_id AND r.item = o.entity_label JOIN main.sales.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = r.entity WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: pairs
datasets.sql: SELECT r.item, c.plan_type, r.score, r.entity FROM main.sales.next_offer_out__recs AS r JOIN main.sales.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = r.entity

datasets.name: items
datasets.sql: SELECT r.item, AVG(r.score) AS lift, COUNT(*) AS offered FROM main.sales.next_offer_out__recs AS r GROUP BY r.item

charts.title: Which offers fit which plans
charts.hint: Average score of each offer for customers on each plan.
charts.so_what: Dark cells are where an offer fits a whole plan: send it there first.

charts.title: Lift against how often it is offered
charts.hint: Each dot is an offer: right is offered more, up is a better fit.
charts.so_what: Offers high and to the left fit well but are rarely sent: send them more.

charts.title: Customers covered by each offer
charts.hint: How many customers have each offer in their top picks.
charts.so_what: An offer that covers few customers needs its own campaign, not the desk.

records.title: Offers to send
records.hint: The top offers for each customer from the latest run, best first.
